## 1. Rewrite the Bun guide's instrumentation step around @sentry/bun/plugin

**Audit item:** DOC-B1 · **Type:** docs-change · **Finding:** The guide states the instrumentation model backwards and never names the plugin

The Bun guide at `guides/bun/index.mdx:94` and `:106` tells the user to run `bun --preload ./instrument.js app.js`, and the alert at `:96-100` states that Sentry's auto-instrumentation does not work with bundled code and that bundling requires manual instrumentation. `@sentry/bun/plugin` is not named anywhere on the page, and `logs` is used as an onboarding block at `:182` but is missing from the options at `:20-22`.

What was observed on bun 1.4.0: a bundle built with `Bun.build({ plugins: [sentryBunPlugin()] })` from `@sentry/bun/plugin` records library and framework spans, while running the same app unbundled with `bun run` records none. `packages/bun/src/plugin.ts:14` states the plugin is build-only. The unbundled diagnostic message is printed only with `debug: true`.

What to change:

- Keep the `--preload` step, described as what guarantees init order.
- Add a "Build with the Sentry plugin" step showing `Bun.build({ entrypoints: [...], plugins: [sentryBunPlugin()] })` imported from `@sentry/bun/plugin`.
- Replace the alert at `:96-100` with a plain statement: library and framework instrumentation requires a build with the plugin; `bun run` on unbundled source records manual spans plus `Bun.serve`, `node:http` and `fetch` spans.
- Add `logs` to the onboarding options at `:20-22`, or remove the block at `:182`.

---

_From the runtime docs audit of September 2026, item DOC-B1, see the [docs audit](https://github.com/JPeer264/sentry-repros/blob/issue-linear-runtime-improvements/_reports/docs-audit.html) in the runtime audit repository. Behavior verified on `getsentry/sentry-javascript` develop at `6f2da7483d` (package 10.67.0) against docs at `046ce5942`; citations re-checked on 2026-09-07 against docs `b568ebbd3` and develop `d6426ad581`._

## 2. Fix inverted traceLifecycle default in the stream mode includes

**Audit item:** DOC-R1 · **Type:** docs-change · **Finding:** Stream-mode includes call `'static'` the default; develop defaults to `'stream'`

The three stream-mode includes present stream mode as opt-in. `platform-includes/performance/enable-stream-mode/javascript.bun.mdx:5` (and `javascript.deno.mdx:5`, `javascript.cloudflare.mdx:8`) say "Opt in by setting the `traceLifecycle` option to `'stream'`", and each closes with "set `traceLifecycle` to `'static'` (the default)" (`javascript.bun.mdx:25`, `javascript.deno.mdx:24`, `javascript.cloudflare.mdx:62`).

On develop the default is `'stream'`. `packages/core/src/client.ts:242` normalizes `traceLifecycle: options.traceLifecycle === 'static' ? 'static' : 'stream'`, so every value except an explicit `'static'` resolves to stream. No runtime overrides this, and `packages/deno/src/integrations/deno-serve.ts:28` describes `'stream'` as the default too.

**What to change**

- Reframe all three includes as opt-out: `'stream'` is the default, `'static'` is what a user sets.
- Replace the `traceLifecycle: "stream"` sample lines with `"static"` examples, or drop them.
- Add the missing comma after `tracesSampleRate: 0.2` at `javascript.cloudflare.mdx:19`.

---

_From the runtime docs audit of September 2026, item DOC-R1, see the [docs audit](https://github.com/JPeer264/sentry-repros/blob/issue-linear-runtime-improvements/_reports/docs-audit.html) in the runtime audit repository. Behavior verified on `getsentry/sentry-javascript` develop at `6f2da7483d` (package 10.67.0) against docs at `046ce5942`; citations re-checked on 2026-09-07 against docs `b568ebbd3` and develop `d6426ad581`._

## 3. Stop recommending denoCronIntegration() on the Deno crons page

**Audit item:** DOC-R2 · **Type:** docs-change · **Finding:** Deno crons page recommends denoCronIntegration(), which throws on Deno 2.9

`platform-includes/crons/setup/javascript.deno.mdx:1` heads its first section "Automatic Check-Ins (Recommended)" and `:12` tells the reader to pass `Sentry.denoCronIntegration()` to `Sentry.init`.

That call crashes startup on current Deno. `packages/deno/src/integrations/deno-cron.ts:23` assigns `Deno.cron = new Proxy(Deno.cron, ...)`, but on Deno 2.9.0 `Deno.cron` is a getter-only property, so `Sentry.init` throws `TypeError: Cannot set property cron of #<Object> which has only a getter`. This reproduced in four separate audit runs. Line 18 returns silently when `Deno.cron` is missing, so without `--unstable-cron` the integration is a no-op. It is also not in the default set at `packages/deno/src/sdk.ts:31-49`, contrary to its JSDoc at `deno-cron.ts:64`.

**What to change**

- Remove the "Recommended" framing and the `denoCronIntegration()` snippet, or label the integration as broken on Deno 2.9.
- Lead with the `Sentry.withMonitor` / `Sentry.captureCheckIn` sections already on the page.
- State that `Deno.cron` needs `--unstable-cron`.

---

_From the runtime docs audit of September 2026, item DOC-R2, see the [docs audit](https://github.com/JPeer264/sentry-repros/blob/issue-linear-runtime-improvements/_reports/docs-audit.html) in the runtime audit repository. Behavior verified on `getsentry/sentry-javascript` develop at `6f2da7483d` (package 10.67.0) against docs at `046ce5942`; citations re-checked on 2026-09-07 against docs `b568ebbd3` and develop `d6426ad581`._

## 4. Rewrite the Bun OpenTelemetry setup includes against develop

**Audit item:** DOC-R20 · **Type:** docs-change · **Finding:** Bun OpenTelemetry setup includes import @sentry/node-core and call APIs that no longer exist

**Note.** owned by Linear SDK-1351 (removal of the custom OpenTelemetry setup page); do not file separately.

Three Bun OpenTelemetry includes are written against a package and APIs that no longer exist. `platform-includes/performance/opentelemetry-setup/javascript.bun.mdx:5` and `:48` import `SentryContextManager, validateOpenTelemetrySetup` from `@sentry/node-core`; `error-monitoring-only/javascript.bun.mdx:3` and `with-custom-sampler/javascript.bun.mdx:3` do the same. `javascript.bun.mdx:12` and `:55` pass `skipOpenTelemetrySetup: true`, and `error-monitoring-only/javascript.bun.mdx:30` calls `provider.addSpanProcessor(...)`.

On develop there is no `node-core` package under `packages/`. `skipOpenTelemetrySetup`, `SentryContextManager`, `validateOpenTelemetrySetup` and `SentrySpanProcessor` appear nowhere in `packages/*/src`. `@sentry/opentelemetry` exports only `getScopesFromContext`, `SentryPropagator`, `SentryTracerProvider`, `setOpenTelemetryContextAsyncContextStrategy` and `registerPrepareSpanScope` (`packages/opentelemetry/src/index.ts:1-9`). The Bun option is `enableOpenTelemetrySetup` (`packages/bun/src/types.ts:23`), and `addSpanProcessor` was removed in OpenTelemetry JS 2.x.

**What to change**

- Drop every `@sentry/node-core` import and the removed symbols.
- Replace `skipOpenTelemetrySetup: true` with `enableOpenTelemetrySetup: false`.
- Replace `provider.addSpanProcessor(...)` with the constructor's `spanProcessors` array.

---

_From the runtime docs audit of September 2026, item DOC-R20, see the [docs audit](https://github.com/JPeer264/sentry-repros/blob/issue-linear-runtime-improvements/_reports/docs-audit.html) in the runtime audit repository. Behavior verified on `getsentry/sentry-javascript` develop at `6f2da7483d` (package 10.67.0) against docs at `046ce5942`; citations re-checked on 2026-09-07 against docs `b568ebbd3` and develop `d6426ad581`._

## 5. Correct the Agents SDK span attribute and conversation ID claims

**Audit item:** DOC-R13 · **Type:** docs-change · **Finding:** Agents SDK page claims instance-name span attributes and instance-name conversation IDs; neither is true

`docs/platforms/javascript/guides/cloudflare/features/agents-sdk.mdx:10` says callable RPC spans carry "the agent class and instance name as attributes". `:39` says "The automatic conversation ID defaults to the **agent instance name**", and `:41` builds override guidance on that premise, warning about per-user instances and singletons named `"default"`.

Neither claim holds on develop. `packages/cloudflare/src/instrumentations/agents/types.ts:61-70` builds the span attributes from `instance._ParentClass?.name` alone, setting `gen_ai.agent.name` to the base agent class; no instance name is attached. The conversation id is a `uuid4()` minted per instance and persisted to Durable Object storage (`types.ts:173`, `:180`), rotated to a fresh `uuid4()` when `message:clear` fires (`instrumentChatAgentConversation.ts:34-36`). `types.ts:104` says the instance `name` is deliberately not used.

**What to change**

- Fix `:10` to name only the agent class attribute.
- Rewrite the Conversation IDs section around a generated uuid4 per instance that rotates on chat clear.
- Replace the `"default"` / per-user override rationale, which rests on the false premise.

---

Behavior verified on `getsentry/sentry-javascript` develop at `6f2da7483d` (package 10.67.0) against docs at `046ce5942`; citations re-checked on 2026-09-07 against docs `b568ebbd3` and develop `d6426ad581`._

## 6. Document the instrument.server file and the wranglerConfigPath requirement on the Cloudflare Vite plugin page

**Audit item:** DOC-Q2 · **Type:** docs-change · **Finding:** The Cloudflare Vite plugin reads its options from an undocumented file and is a silent no-op without the wrangler config path

`guides/cloudflare/features/vite-plugin.mdx` and the proposed quick start step 3 present `sentryCloudflareVitePlugin()` as a drop-in: add it next to `cloudflare()`, build, deploy. ## 95. Update the Node getting-started page for --require and for first-line ESM imports

**Audit item:** DOC-Q5 · **Type:** docs-change · **Finding:** Node guide: the --require flag prints an undocumented "no longer supported" banner, and the ordering warning is stricter than develop

`platform-includes/getting-started-node/javascript.mdx:93-96` shows `node --import ./instrument.mjs app.mjs`, and `:55` warns that importing the instrument file later than first means auto-instrumentation and modules like database monitoring may not work. Nothing on the page mentions `--require`.

Observed on develop with Node v26.5.0: `node --require ./instrument.cjs app.mjs` still delivers the same errors, spans, headers and logs, but its first stderr line is `[Sentry] Initializing the SDK via the Node --require flag is no longer supported, because Node re-runs --require preloads on its module loader thread. Use --import instead`. A first-line `import "./instrument.mjs"` in the entry file gives the same telemetry as the flag, including Express route names and handler spans, because the injection hook is registered while `@sentry/node` evaluates. `NODE_OPTIONS="--import ./instrument.mjs"` is identical to the flag.

What to change:

- Add one sentence that `--require` is no longer supported and prints a banner, with the `--import` replacement.
- Soften the ordering warning at `:55`: a first-line ESM import of the instrument file is equivalent to `--import`; the warning applies to imports that are not first.
- List `NODE_OPTIONS` as an equivalent form.
